newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Gulf rigs unchanged at 169 in the week.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Gulf rigs unchanged at 169 in the week.

text.p: There were 169 rigs under contract in the U.S. Gulf as of May 2, unchanged from the period ending April 25, Offshore Data Services said Friday.
The utilization rate for rigs working in the Gulf, based on a total fleet of 180, was 93.1 percent.
The number of working rigs in the European/Mediterranean area remained unchanged at 103 rigs under contract out of a total fleet of 104, a utilization rate of 99.0 pct.
The worldwide rig count was unchanged at 574 out of a total fleet of 603, with a utilization rate of 95.4 percent.
